instruction: Open the .xcf file from the Desktop, copy it, and paste it into a new LibreOffice Writer document. Add your name 'John Doe' as a header, insert the image below, and save the document as 'header_image.docx' on the Desktop.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);
